_meta.description: product-service-catalogue-public task 4.1. The national list of government products (UPL) as a lookup: one uplProduct per UPL URI, written by `occ pipelinq:upl:import` (UplListImporter) and never by hand, so the schema grants no write verb and follows the register's staff read. The product form offers the list on uplReference through x-options-from; the stored value stays the URI, so a product saved before the import is still valid. hideWhenEmpty keeps the field a free URI input until the list is imported. Product moves to 1.2.1 so OpenRegister writes the picker onto an existing schema.
